QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Food Shortage
QuestInfo.0: You need to tell Peytour about the dearth of food.
QuestInfo.1: Peytour and Chief Kan agree that you're going to need a lot of food to get to the next town safely. They've given you permission to form a hunting party.
QuestInfo.2: Thanks to the skill of the hunting party, you've got plenty of Shrelephant meat for the trip to the next town.

default.0: You sure you have the time to chat with me? Why don't you go and get me some meat?
